name: White Christmas ~Yuki Furu Yoru no Koibito-tachi~
original_name: White Christmas ～雪降る夜の恋人達～
source:
A collection of four short Christmas stories.
Christmas romance mood is poured in a stained city. On this holy night small miracles happen.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
收录四篇圣诞短篇故事。
圣诞节的浪漫气息洒满霓虹斑斓的城市。在这个圣夜，小小的奇迹悄然发生。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
